lane_impact: L1 world-exploration: a latent bug in the original world generator, not a design choice. Because rnd() returns [0,1), rand(3) is confined to {0,1,2}. A faithful 1:1 port must decide explicitly whether to reproduce the bug (always 1 exit) or the evident intent (sometimes 2) - and must say which. Worth checking the sibling getSouth/East/WestExits for the same pattern.
text: TerritoryData.getNorthExits contains a dead branch: rng.rand(3) can only return 0, 1 or 2, but the code tests dice == 3 to set count = 2 - so every territory generates exactly one north exit.
